newsitem.title: SPAIN: CNMV proposes fining BBV 85 mln ptas.
newsitem.headline: CNMV proposes fining BBV 85 mln ptas.

text.p: Spanish Stock Market Commission CNMV proposed on Friday fining Banco Bilbao Vizcaya (BBV) 85 million pesetas following a trading probe.

The CNMV said it opened an investigation in May into BBV, alleging that Spain's second-largest bank had profited from information during Endesa's purchase of regional utility Sevillana de Electricidad that should have remained confined to one department.
BBV denied it had violated any rules.

In a statement, the CNMV said it had proposed imposing a fine of 85 million pesetas for related infractions. In addition, the CNMV has proposed prohibiting BBV for a period of one year from buying shares in listed companies through third parties without prior notice to the CNMV.
The government must approve the sanctions.
The CNMV also said its board had absolved BBV officer Javier Echenique of any responsibility.
